message: Last week, I experienced my first blackout with my friend who has a knack for panicking at the slightest hiccup. As the lights flickered off, she started searching for candles, but I reassured her that my trusty flashlight and some power banks were all we really needed. We ended up having a cozy night filled with stories and snacks, proving that a little prep can turn a power outage into an unexpected adventure. How do you keep the mood up during unexpected blackouts?
